name: sagabet-livestats
description: Browser extension adding live match statistics to epicbet's placed-bets view

scripts.test: node scripts/test-matcher.mjs && node scripts/test-extract.mjs && node scripts/test-normalize.mjs && node scripts/test-render.mjs && npm run build >/dev/null && node scripts/test-bundle.mjs
scripts.lint: npm run build >/dev/null && npx --yes addons-linter --self-hosted dist/firefox-mv2
scripts.lint:listed: npm run build >/dev/null && npx --yes addons-linter dist/firefox-listed
